descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S17 「养老院记录：没有签名或日期行，没有 'yesterday'；针对性的 fixture，加上每份养老院记录」 Nursing Home notes: no signature or date line and no 'yesterday', targeted fixtures plus every Nursing Home note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 Nursing Home notes have no signature or date line (PR #57) and never say 'yesterday'.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Three Nursing Home visits that tempt a 'yesterday' (a visit two weeks after the last one, a visit the day after a fall visit, a dictated 'yesterday'), and every Nursing Home note from S12 to S19

When Each targeted fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote; the same checks run on every Nursing Home note of this matrix

Then No signature block, provider line or date line; no 'yesterday' unless the physician dictated it (N-20, recorded only)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：mustNotInclude and noLineMatches below on every Nursing Home note except N-20, whose 'yesterday' is recorded (Q6). A header date-of-service line is tagged with Q8. On main noteSnfPatientContext never sends previousNotes to the model (they feed only groundingSource for the unit scrub), so the prior-visit facts that tempt a 'yesterday' are given in the background line (fixture ' …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
